items.quote: So I rise today to support President Trump's wisdom and leadership in decisively countering Iran's nuclear threat and, therefore, to oppose this ill-conceived joint resolution.
I cannot and I will not support a resolution that removes the ability of the President of the United States to act decisively in defense of national interests, our allies, and our Armed Forces.
items.promise: Said he will not support a resolution that removes the President's ability to act decisively in defense of national interests, allies, and the Armed Forces.

items.quote: Mr. President, I rise today in support of my legislation, the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act--otherwise known as the GENIUS Act.
I look forward to getting the GENIUS Act signed into law in very short order.

Mr. President, I thank the Senator from New Jersey for yielding, and reiterate that section 9, Anti-Money Laundering Innovation, was added to the GENIUS Act to enable the Federal Government to address illicit activities involving stablecoins by directing the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) to establish guidance and notice and comment rulemaking relating to the factors set forth in sections 9(d)(1)-9(d)(4).

I oppose Central Bank Digital Currencies. They are a threat to Americans' freedom and privacy.

We need private-sector innovation and competition to drive stablecoin innovation in America.
items.promise: Said he opposes central bank digital currencies as a threat to freedom and privacy.

items.quote: We have 1,200 miles of common border with Mexico, and the open border policies of the Biden administration have been an unmitigated disaster from a public health standpoint and a public safety standpoint.

This border crisis, as I indicated, is one that President Biden himself practically invited-- invited--during his first campaign when he encouraged migrants to ``immediately surge the border.'' I mean, this is crazy talk if you think about it, but that is what he said.
And by actually enforcing border security, you can deter people from coming in the first place.
Earlier this year, I introduced the Foreign Investment Guardrails to Help Thwart China Act, or the FIGHT China Act, as it is called.
But one of the things that I am going to be focusing on as part of this Defense authorization bill is to finally address outbound investment in China.

So I look forward to working with all of our colleagues, as well as President Trump, to come up with the right solution for healthcare that actually relieves the burden of rising health costs on American families, primarily caused by the abomination known as ObamaCare.

I know some would like to blame Israel and the Israeli Defense Forces and Prime Minister Netanyahu, but the reason for the humanitarian disaster that has been Gaza for the last 2 years is because of Hamas.

Blue city liberal mayors are defying federal law, ignoring ICE detainers & not cooperating with @RealTomHoman or border enforcement agencies.
 
I support @POTUS holding these mayors accountable & keep our communities safe.
items.promise: Said he supports the President holding sanctuary mayors accountable on ICE detainers.

items.quote: Mr. President, I rise to join my colleagues who are in support of Senator Kaine's, I think, thoughtful approach on how we can put an end to this tariff war with Canada.
I need Tim Kaine optimism today because the long-awaited Republican budget resolution adds $6 trillion to the deficit--$4 trillion in funny math and about another $2 trillion for tax cuts.
So I would hope that folks on both sides of the aisle will actually stand up to ``America First.'' Reject this misguided tariff strategy.
Frankly, I have some fights on this side of the aisle because I actually support all of the above in terms of our energy mix.
I am all for the natural gas jobs coming out of the Presiding Officer's State.

But I would urge the Senate not to take this flimflam, do-nothing bill but actually take a look at my Data Center Tax Accountability and Disclosure Act, which I didn't dream up in the last couple of days but put forward much earlier this summer on an issue that I have been working on for a couple of years.

I am not going to raise anybody's taxes, but we have given these hyperscalers, we have given these data center builders enormous tax benefits and bonus depreciation where they can write off the cost of these very expensive centers all in the first year.
If the SAVE Act comes up in the Senate, I will vote no.
items.promise: Said he will vote no if the SAVE Act comes up in the Senate.

items.quote: The “Big Beautiful Bill” is a giveaway to billionaires on the backs of the working class. I will vote hell no.
items.promise: Said he will vote no on the “Big Beautiful Bill.”

items.quote: Since the day this regulation was finalized last November, I pledged that I would work with President Trump and my colleagues in the Congress to repeal this misguided, anti-energy tax.
items.promise: Said she pledged to work with President Trump and colleagues to repeal the Biden waste emissions / natural gas tax.

items.quote: I encourage my colleagues to support the CRA that is central to our mission of American energy dominance and reject this tax that will bolster our adversaries, increase energy costs on American families, and put our energy future at risk.

Right now, we have the momentum, I believe, needed to deliver meaningful and lasting reforms to the environmental review and permitting process, and I believe this is an unprecedented opportunity and something we can truly accomplish.

I have seen firsthand how projects that our communities rely on face needless delays and how costs are then shifted to our families, who pay more for energy, housing, transportation, and basic goods as a result.

Mr. President, as chairman of the Environment and Public Works Committee, I rise in support of my resolution to block the Biden EPA's rule approving California's Clean Air Act waiver for its Advanced Clean Cars II regulation.
The SAVE America Act closes this illegal voting loophole by requiring photo ID to vote, proof of citizenship to register, and requiring States to remove noncitizens from the voter rolls.
It doesn't allow men in women's sports, and I have long championed this issue of such importance to our girls in West Virginia and across the Nation.
I urge my colleagues to end this shutdown, restore stability, and put the safety of our Nation first.

West Virginia has been hit harder than any other state by the Fentanyl crisis and I support taking all available steps to stop the flow of illegal opioids into our country.

@POTUS and his administration are committed to making our country safe.
items.promise: Said she supports taking all available steps to stop the flow of illegal opioids into the country.

items.quote: Mr. President, I rise today to speak about the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, also known as the CLARITY Act, and about the years of work that brought us to this moment.

This is why I am working day and night on bipartisan digital asset market structure legislation which will ensure that commonsense illicit finance rules apply to digital asset exchanges and that bad actors that use digital assets are rooted out.
There is a renewed sense of optimism and energy around market structure talks today, and I am hopeful that we will have legislation on the Senate floor before the end of this year.

President Trump’s objective is clear: Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon.

I will vote to support @POTUS and give him all the tools available to defend America’s interests.
items.promise: Said she will vote to support the President and give him tools to defend America’s interests regarding Iran.

items.quote: Israel remains one of America's most steadfast allies, and I support its right to engage in defensive actions to protect its people.
items.promise: Said she supports Israel's right to engage in defensive actions to protect its people.

items.quote: This resolution, if passed, would send a dangerous message not just to Iran's terrorist-sponsoring regime but also to every adversary who is seeking to exploit our domestic debates and internal divisions.
With this bill, the United States is one step closer to becoming the global leader in crypto.
First of all, this is a very good bill--good for the country, good for consumers, and good for the people we all represent on both sides of this aisle.
I wanted to do everything I could to keep those companies in Wyoming and, more importantly, to keep them in America.
For those constitutional reasons alone, I cannot support this resolution.
This bill has so many technical flaws that I don't know where to start.
